# Arrabon Services

> Arrabon Services builds custom business software for South African small and medium businesses: systems shaped around how a business actually runs, replacing WhatsApp groups, spreadsheets and paper forms. Based in Brooklyn, Pretoria, Gauteng. Arrabon builds a free working demo within five days, then builds, hosts and supports the full system on one monthly licence.

## Systems built

- ITC Automation System (financial services, in build for a mortgage originator): pipeline tracking, consent-first credit reports pulled into each client record, automated client communication.
- Personal Training Management System (fitness, live since September 2026): one calendar across every trainer, sessions logged from the phone, per-trainer pay, monthly stats and reminders.
- Pet Sitting Management System (pet services, live since July 2026): scheduling, job posting and sitter coordination for an agency running 40+ sitters, which previously received 50 to 80 WhatsApp messages a day on one phone.

## How Arrabon works

1. One conversation about how the business runs today.
2. Scope and price agreed in writing, with payment tied to milestones.
3. The system is purpose-built, not configured from someone else's product.
4. The client uses a working version early, while it is still cheap to change.
5. Milestones fall due only once the system runs on real work.
